text:
elaine: quick async check-in — model onboarding + evals. TL;DR: merged tokenizer fix, ran baseline evals, seeing a small BLEU dip on prompt_set_v2.

elaine: yesterday: landed tokenization fix for redwood/llama3-13b-q4 (PR #842), verified inference unit tests, started full eval sweep overnight.

jin: nice — saw the PR, left one tiny comment on the token boundary test. looks good otherwise.

alex: blocker: the nightly eval job OOM'd at step 512 on a3-small-q; logs show kv-cache spike. I can repro locally.

elaine: thanks alex — can you drop the log snippet here? also which commit hash?

alex: commit 9a1f3b2. log: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2Gbytes (at step 512)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "evals/runner.py", line 238, in run_batch
    out = model.generate(batch)
```

maria: ping on that — if it's KV growth, try lowering max_tokens or switch to continuous-batch mode for this run. I can add a guard in the eval harness to retry with batch_size=1.

elaine: good idea. I'll queue a retry with batch_size=1 and max_tokens=256.

sam: FYI I updated prompt_set_v2 to fix an edge-case that was triggering hallucinations on product-descriptions; change is at prompts/prompt_set_v2.json (comment included). may explain the BLEU drop.

jin: can you link the diff? curious what changed.

sam: https://git.internal/redwood/prompt-runs/commit/2b7f0e — main change: added explicit instructions to prefer brevity and include source citations when available.

elaine: that explains it. new instruction tradeoff: lower BLEU but better factuality for our eval. we should add a secondary metric (factuality score) to the dashboard.

maria: I can add a quick Eval job that computes F1/citation-precision on the same set. will run after alex's retry.

ci-bot: Build redwood/llama3-13b-q4 PR #842 passed all checks on branch 'main' — 1 artifact generated: s3://redwood-artifacts/842/llama3-tokenfix.tar.gz :thumbsup:

alex: re-run started with batch_size=1. kicked off `kubectl exec -it eval-runner -- python evals/run.py --model redwood/llama3-13b-q4 --prompts prompts/prompt_set_v2.json --batch 1 --max_tokens 256`

elaine: thanks. next up today: (1) monitor retry, (2) add factuality metric to dashboard, (3) follow up on PR comment and merge after CI green.

jin: I'll help instrument the kv-cache metrics in the runner so we get a per-step memory curve. should help find when growth happens.

sam: small ask — can someone review my prompt edit? it's low-risk but want a quick sanity check for wording.

maria: happy to review now.

elaine: awesome — if everything passes, we can roll the prompt update to canary later today and watch production regression alerts. :eyes: 

alex: update (later): retry finished, no OOMs, full sweep completed. BLEU dropped ~3.1 points vs baseline but citation-precision up 12%. attaching quick numbers in next thread.

elaine: perfect. follow-ups: create a dashboard card for citation-precision, schedule a short sync if regressions persist after canary. otherwise no blockers from me. :rocket:
